factual_claims.source_evidence: The Group continues to invest in new product development and product enhancements, as well as in sales promotion... The Group’s expenses did not exceed the amounts planned in the budget.

factual_claims.claim: The global shortage of electronic components affected operations, but the company had accumulated material reserves to maintain delivery times, which have recently improved.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Group’s operations were affected by the global shortage of various electronic components... accumulated material reserves... Delivery times have continued to improve recently.

factual_claims.claim: Financial position remained strong with a net cash flow of EUR 2.6 million for the year and a cash balance of EUR 4.8 million at period end.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Group’s net cash flow for the 12 months of the financial year is EUR 2.6 million... cash balance in the balance sheet at the end of the period was EUR 4.8 million.

factual_claims.claim: Customer advances increased substantially to EUR 3.9 million from EUR 759 thousand the previous year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Customer prepayments for goods and services: EUR 3,916,211 (2025) vs EUR 759,290 (2024) (Balance Sheet Note 12).

factual_claims.claim: Total assets grew to EUR 25.9 million, driven by an 8% increase in inventories to EUR 13.9 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Total assets: EUR 25,916,954 (2025). Inventories: EUR 13,939,318 (2025), representing an 8% increase from EUR 12,860,883 (2024) (Note 3).

factual_claims.claim: The company maintained liquidity through an unused EUR 4.95 million credit line with Luminor Bank.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: To ensure liquidity, the Parent Company has a Credit Line Agreement with Luminor Bank AS for a total amount of EUR 4.95 million, which had not been utilised at the end of the reporting period. (Note 5).

factual_claims.claim: Employee count increased slightly to 273 from 265.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: As of June 30, 2025, the Group had 273 employees (265 employees as of June 30, 2024) (Guidelines section).

factual_claims.claim: The Board remains cautious regarding future forecasts, aiming to stabilize turnover to ensure long-term positive net results amidst ongoing global business uncertainty.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The company’s goal is to stabilize turnover to ensure a positive net result in the long term. The Board of SAF Tehnika remains cautious and refrains from providing specific sales and performance forecasts.

numerical_claims.claim: consolidated net turnover of EUR 26.11 million for the twelve months ended June 30, 2025, representing a 4% decline compared to EUR 27.09 million in the previous financial year
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: For the 12 months of the 2024/2025 financial year, the Group’s unaudited consolidated turnover was EUR 26.11 million, a 4% decline from the previous financial year’s revenue.

numerical_claims.claim: net turnover decreased by 13% to EUR 5.18 million from EUR 5.98 million in the prior year period
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: The Group’s unaudited consolidated net turnover for the fourth quarter (Q4) of the 2024/2025 financial year (FY) was EUR 5.18 million, representing a 13% decrease compared to the same period in FY 2023/2024.

numerical_claims.claim: net loss of EUR 820 thousand for the full year, a significant improvement from the EUR 2.37 million loss reported in the 2023/2024 financial year
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: The consolidated unaudited result for the twelve months of the 2024/2025 financial year is a loss of EUR 820 thousand. The Group reported a loss of EUR 2.37 million for the 2023/2024 financial year. Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss shows precise figures.

numerical_claims.claim: increased loss of EUR 913 thousand, compared to a EUR 498 thousand loss in the same quarter of the previous year
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: The Group closed the fourth quarter of the 2024/2025 financial year with a loss of EUR 913 thousand... In Q4 of the previous year, the Group recorded a loss of EUR 498 thousand. Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss for Q4 shows precise figures.

numerical_claims.claim: Earnings before interest and taxes for the twelve months were a loss of EUR 754 thousand, while the quarterly EBIT loss widened to EUR 863 thousand
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 754,000 EUR loss (12-month EBIT), 863,000 EUR loss (Q4 EBIT)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 754,187 EUR loss (12-month EBIT), 863,273 EUR loss (Q4 EBIT)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss for 12 months: EBIT (754,187) EUR. Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss for Q4: EBIT (863,273) EUR.

numerical_claims.claim: North and Latin America, which accounted for 55% of annual turnover, revenue fell by 14% to EUR 14.28 million
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 14,282,812 EUR (North/Latin America 2024/2025), decrease of 14% from 16,603,697 EUR (2023/2024)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: Over a 12-month period, revenues in North and Latin Americas... amounted to EUR 14.28 million, thus showing a 14% decrease... Note 8 table shows precise figures.

numerical_claims.claim: European revenues grew by 17% to EUR 10.04 million, representing 38% of total turnover
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 38% of the total turnover comes from revenues generated in European countries, which increased by 17%... and amount to EUR 10.04 million. Note 8 table shows precise figures.

numerical_claims.claim: Asia, Africa, and Middle East region saw a slight 5% decline to EUR 1.78 million
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: Revenue from the Asia, Africa and the Middle East region declined by 5%... Note 8 table shows precise figures.

numerical_claims.claim: 40% drop in North and Latin American sales, while European sales increased by 24% and Asia, Africa, and Middle East sales doubled
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 40% decrease (North/Latin America Q4), 24% increase (Europe Q4), 100% increase (Asia/Africa/ME Q4)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: North/Latin America Q4 2024/2025: EUR 2.5 million (40% decrease from prior year). Europe Q4 2024/2025: EUR 1.9 million (24% increase). Asia/Africa/ME Q4 2024/2025: EUR 846 thousand (doubled from prior year)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: The turnover of the North America and Latin America region... decreased by 40%. The European region... increase of 24%. Asia, Africa and Middle East region doubled compared with the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year...

numerical_claims.candidate_value: 10.58 million EUR (salaries/social 2024/2025), 1.82 million EUR (bonuses 2024/2025), 942,000 EUR (bonuses 2023/2024), 8% increase (salaries/social)
